description_sq:
Super zyra per shitje te investuara se fundmi ne Kompleksin Delijorgji!
Zyrat pozicionohen ne katin e pare te objektit qe eshte i destinuar vetem per njesi biznesi/zyra.
Ambjenti ka hyrje te dedikuar per pjesen e bizneseve/zyrave, ka dy vetrata qe ben te mundur reklamimin e biznesit pasi njera nga fasadat ka shikueshmeri te larte nga Rr. "Kavajes".
Zyra eshte investuar dhe mobiluar rreth 6 muaj me pare dhe shitet e mobiluar, ne cmim perfshihen edhe dy poste parkimi.
description_en: Super office for sale recently invested in Delijorgji Complex! The offices are located on the first floor of the building, which is intended only for business/office units. The premises have a dedicated entrance for the part of businesses/offices, there are two windows that make it possible to advertise the business since one of the facades has high visibility from Rr. "Kavajes". The office was invested and furnished about 6 months ago and is being sold furnished, the price includes two parking spaces.
